prompt: Create a cinematic, polished, naturally realistic studio portrait of a handsome young adult man facing the camera head-on from mid-chest up. He has thick tousled dark brown hair with volume, warm brown eyes, strong brows, subtle stubble and a faint mustache, a defined jawline, and a calm serious expression with closed lips. Dress him in a plain off-white crewneck sweatshirt. Use dramatic movie-style lighting with a warm amber key/rim light from the viewer’s left catching the hair, cheek, ear, and shoulder, balanced by a cool cyan-blue rim/fill light from the viewer’s right. Set him against a dark smoky blue-black studio background with a soft teal glow on the right side, shallow depth of field, crisp facial detail, realistic skin texture, natural pores, glossy catchlights, and high-end editorial color grading. Center the subject symmetrically, vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no accessories, no watermark, no extra people.
